subject: PO controls, issuance SLA & line-item schema — Helios onboarding kickoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helios-systems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: PO controls, issuance SLA & line-item schema — Helios onboarding kickoff

Hi Sara —

Thanks for signing up to move forward with Redwood. As part of the vendor activation and PO setup we want to confirm a few mandatory fields and timings so Finance and Ops can process POs cleanly. Can you confirm the items below by EOD tomorrow? We can take a quick 20-min call if easier.

Key asks from our side:
- Legal & accounting fields: official vendor name, DBA (if any), EIN/tax id, remittance address, and AP contact for invoice routing.
- PO issuance SLA: our usual standard is 7 business-day PO issuance after intake sign-off; let us know if your internal procurement requires a different lead time.
- Line-item granularity: we typically require a CSV with the following columns: service_code, description, quantity, unit_of_measure, unit_price, start_date, end_date, accounting_segment (GL/Cost center), taxable (yes/no), item_sku (if applicable). We attached a sample template — please confirm the columns you can populate.
- Invoicing rules: do you accept partial invoices? net terms (Net30 default, special cases require approvals), and preferred invoice delivery method (email/AP portal).
- Contract/PO acceptance: are there any routing steps on your side (e.g., internal PO acceptance required by contract team) that could add latency?

Attachments: Helios vendor intake form (if you’ve started it), sample-lineitem-template.csv (for our PO export).

Next steps: please reply with the EIN and AP contact + any exceptions on the column set. If everything looks standard we’ll proceed to provision the initial PO and target issuance within 7 business days from receipt of completed intake.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helios-systems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Helios Systems Procurement <po-team@helios-systems.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO controls, issuance SLA & line-item schema — Helios onboarding kickoff

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — looping in our procurement inbox and AP lead. Quick answers below and attaching our completed vendor onboarding form.

- Official name: Helios Systems, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789 (W-9 attached)
- Remit: 101 Innovation Dr, Suite 400, Palo Alto, CA 94043
- AP contact: Dana Patel (dana.patel@helios-systems.com), +1 650-555-0198

On your questions:
- PO SLA: We can accommodate your 7 business-day issuance. If an expedited PO is needed we can sometimes expedite in 2-3 business days but that requires a written request from the buyer.
- Line-item template: We can provide service_code, description, quantity, uom, unit_price, start/end dates, and item_sku. We do not currently populate accounting_segment values on our invoice (we rely on buyer-provided accounting segments) — will that work?
- Partial invoices: Yes, we can submit partial invoices for milestone-based work.
- Invoice delivery: Email to AP inbox (ap@helios-systems.com) preferred; we also support attachments as PDF.

Attachments: helios_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, helios_w9_signed.pdf

Let me know if you need additional tax documentation or a specific GL mapping. If useful we can do a 15-min sync tomorrow morning.

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Vendor Operations
Helios Systems

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helios-systems.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO controls, issuance SLA & line-item schema — Helios onboarding kickoff

Sara —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9. A couple of clarifications so Finance can ingest Helios invoices without manual mapping: 

1) Accounting segment: we will push accounting_segment values on the PO (GL and cost center). To avoid rework please include a blank column named accounting_segment in your final invoice CSV so our AP system can match. If you cannot populate it, we will add it during PO creation but that will require us to hold invoices for matching.

2) Item-level tax: please include a taxable column with yes/no per line. Our tax engine expects per-line tax flags for some services.

3) Service codes: we prefer stable service_code strings (e.g., HEL-ENG-SUPPORT) rather than free-form descriptions for reconciliation. If you can provide a mapping file between item_sku and service_code that would speed things up.

4) Remittance note: please confirm if you accept electronic ACH and provide bank details for our AP vault (we will transmit via secure portal).

5) PO change handling: Redwood policy is to issue change orders for any >10% delta on quantity or >$5k per-line increase. Can Helios accept change-order POs or do you require new POs for amendments?

Drive link: sample line-item template and an example PO export are in the shared Drive (see link).

If Helios can return a sample invoice in CSV (filled) using the attached template we can do a dry-run and issue a stub PO within 2 business days after that.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: PO controls, issuance SLA & line-item schema — Helios onboarding kickoff

Laura / Karthik —

Thanks for the clarifications. We can add a blank accounting_segment column to our CSV export (we'll leave it empty where not provided) and include a taxable=yes/no flag. We will also prepare a mapping file between our item_sku and recommended service_code strings and upload a filled sample invoice to the Drive link by EOD tomorrow.

Regarding change orders: we can accept change-order POs if the buyer issues an official PO amendment document referencing the original PO number — that works for our contract team.

ACH: we can accept ACH. I'll attach a scanned bank confirmation and Dana will provide secure bank details via the vendor portal.

Estimated timeline: return filled sample invoice + mapping file by 2027-10-11 COB. If you can issue the stub PO after the dry-run we aim to have a live PO issued by 2027-10-18 (within your 7 business-day SLA after dry-run).

Attachments: helios_sample_invoice_filled.csv (to be uploaded), bank-confirmation-stub.pdf

Best,
Sara Nguyen
Vendor Operations
Helios Systems
